integrity_caveat: Unsigned integrity metadata; this packaging step neither executes workloads nor verifies branch publication.

limits.enforcement: Source and published byte totals and the complete uncompressed tar are separately capped; compressed writes are bounded before output publication.

path_transform.algorithm: Ordered, literal UTF-8 byte replacement; all other bytes, including line endings and embedded raw hashes, are retained.
path_transform.commit_exception: identities/*.commit are exact original Git commit object payload bytes and receive no substitutions.
path_transform.hash_semantics: Hashes and sizes inside reports and agent notes continue to describe raw originals. Use member published_sha256 and published_size_bytes to verify distributed files.

scope: Supplemental local tensor evidence snapshot; no vendor or phase-gate qualification is inferred.
snapshot_policy: No wall-clock packaging timestamp is added. Identical selected inputs and roots produce identical outputs. Rebuild after all desired reports and the final ledger are available.
